title: P3.9-B South Cotabato-Sarangani road eases travel for Mindanao farmers

blocks.text: KORONADAL CITY — Farmers in upland communities in Tupi, South Cotabato, are finding it easier to travel and bring their agricultural products to market following improvements along the P3.9-billion Banga-Tupi-Malungon Road. The road project, which connects parts of South Cotabato and Sarangani provinces, has improved access to farming communities where residents previously had to walk for hours or rely on horses to transport their harvests. Johnny Bawik, a farmer from Sitio Acfaon in Barangay Bunao, Tupi, said traveling to and from their community used to be difficult because of poor road conditions.
